top_signals.title: Fed’s Cook Sees Growing Urgency to Tackle Inflation
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook sees an urgent need for the US central bank to raise interest rates to bring down inflation. Cook said Friday at a conference at Chile’s central bank in Santiago, “Inflation has been above target for more than five and a half years, and every additional day poses greater risk that price- and wage-setters will adjust their inflation expectations upward.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Expands Oil Storage in Japan as Tokyo Restocks
top_signals.summary: Japan plans to buy up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude for the national petroleum reserve it drew down during the Hormuz crisis, under a deal the two countries announced on Friday that makes the purchases subject to favorable market conditions. The deal also gives Saudi Arabia temporary use of an additional 16 million barrels of storage capacity in Japan, expanding the 8 million barrels it already holds there, and the kingdom has begun refilling those tanks, Bloomberg reported.
